meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,当你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex CLI 的 bug 时,Claude 会基于源码和运行时证据调查根因,生成带复现步骤、根因分析和修复建议的英文 GitHub issue(对 openai/codex 可生成 PR),路由到正确的仓库,并打上 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交、分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等 bug 时,尤其是需要溯源根因和修复指导时。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 开一个 bug issue,附上复现步骤。
say.note: Claude 会调查源码并生成结构化 issue。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 报错是上游问题吗?帮我分类并开 issue。
say.note: 他会对比两个仓库源码后决定路由。

say.text: 在 openai/codex 上为这个修复创建 PR。

howto.what_en: When you report a LazyCodex or Codex CLI bug, Claude investigates using source evidence, then generates a structured GitHub issue (or PR for openai/codex) with reproduction, root cause, fix guidance, routes to the correct repo, and labels it lazycodex-generated.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugin, upstream Codex CLI, etc., especially when source-backed root cause and fix guidance are needed.

say_en.text: Please open a bug issue for LazyCodex with reproduction steps.
say_en.note: Claude investigates sources and creates a structured issue.

say_en.text: Is this Codex CLI error an upstream issue? Triage it and open an issue.
say_en.note: It compares both repo sources before routing.

say_en.text: Create a PR on openai/codex for this fix.
say_en.note: Only for openai/codex with an implemented fix.
